declarations.notes: Straight vertical contour parameterized by s = c + i t; principal complex powers are retained, and the source's nonzero phase domain is stated explicitly as z != 0.
Real a and b are made explicit, as required by the source inequalities a > 0 and 0 < b < pi; DLMF notes this as the c = 0, b = a, s = i t, z = exp(i(pi - 2b)) specialization of E1, up to t -> -t.
All four complex real-part conditions are preserved.
Only Re(a+b+c+d) > 3 is assumed, exactly as in the source.
Fin 4 indexing records all four parameters and six pairwise Gamma factors; at t = 0 the totalized quotient has its removable value 0, which does not affect the ordinary integral.

shared_vocabulary_requests: Consolidate verticalLineIntegral if later sections need the same straight vertical contour.
